# DNP3 objects

Every group and variation the `app` package encodes and decodes, from IEEE 1815-2012 Annex A.
The catalog [`app/catalog.json`](app/catalog.json) is the source: this page, the
constants and table of the `app` package and the objects `client.Measurements`
reports are generated from it.

**Size** is the octets of one object; "—" when it is not fixed (packed bits,
free-format and variable-length objects). **Point** marks the data
`client.Measurements` reports.
